outcomes.question: How many orders are in the database?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many customers do we have?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What is the total revenue?
outcomes.sql: SELECT SUM(line_total) AS total_revenue FROM order_items LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many different products have been sold at least once?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) AS distinct_products_sold FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 0 LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What is the average revenue per order?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM (SELECT invoice_no, SUM(line_total) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY invoice_no) AS sub LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: Which 5 countries have the highest revenue?
outcomes.sql: SELECT c.country_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM countries AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.country_id = o.country_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

outcomes.question: Which 10 products have sold the most units?
outcomes.sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.stock_code = oi.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

outcomes.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend?
outcomes.sql: SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no WHERE NOT o.customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

outcomes.question: Which 3 countries placed the most orders?
outcomes.sql: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders AS o JOIN countries AS c ON o.country_id = c.country_id GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 3

outcomes.question: Which product has the most returned units?
outcomes.sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(r.quantity) AS total_returned_units FROM returns AS r JOIN products AS p ON p.stock_code = r.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY total_returned_units DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: Which customer has returned the most units?
outcomes.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_returned FROM returns WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_units_returned DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: How many customers are from Germany?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN countries AS co ON c.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country_name = 'Germany' LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What was the total revenue in November 2011?
outcomes.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no WHERE o.order_date >= '2011-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2011-12-01' LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many orders were placed in each calendar quarter of 2011? Give the quarter number from 1 to 4.
outcomes.sql: SELECT QUARTER(order_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2011-01-01' AND order_date < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY QUARTER(order_date) ORDER BY quarter LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: Which calendar month (year and month) had the highest revenue?
outcomes.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: When was the most recent order placed?
outcomes.sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) AS most_recent_order_date FROM orders LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: Which day of the week has the most orders?
outcomes.sql: SELECT DAYNAME(order_date) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: What percentage of orders were placed by anonymous customers?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS anonymous_orders_percentage FROM orders LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What is the total value of returns?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total), 2) AS total_return_value FROM returns LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many units were returned in total?
outcomes.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_returned FROM returns LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What is the net revenue, meaning sales minus returns?
outcomes.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM order_items) - (SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM returns) AS net_revenue LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many order lines are flagged as outliers?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS outlier_order_lines FROM order_items WHERE is_outlier = 1 LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS frequent_customers LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: What share of total revenue comes from the United Kingdom, as a percentage?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.country_name = 'United Kingdom' THEN oi.line_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS uk_revenue_share_percentage FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.invoice_no = o.invoice_no JOIN countries AS c ON o.country_id = c.country_id LIMIT 200

outcomes.question: Which product earned the most revenue in the United Kingdom?
outcomes.sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.invoice_no = o.invoice_no JOIN countries AS c ON o.country_id = c.country_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.stock_code = p.stock_code WHERE c.country_name = 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: Which customer placed the most orders, and how many?
outcomes.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
